summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of redesigned Blinkit-style Orange Pharmacy page. All 8 requested features tested and working correctly.

issues: Notification popup ('Don't miss important updates!') appears on page load and can block user interaction - consider showing this after user has browsed for a while or on a specific trigger

context_for_next_testing_agent: Pharmacy page redesign complete with Blinkit-style UI. All features working: hero banner, search autocomplete (debounced), category filtering, add to cart with quantity controls, upload prescription dialog, medicine detail dialog, sticky cart bar on mobile, checkout navigation.

hero_banner_and_search.details: Dark green gradient banner with 'Orange Pharmacy' title, '196,370+ medicines' subtitle, search input with clear button

search_autocomplete.details: Debounced search (300ms) returning up to 10 results with medicine name, form, manufacturer, and price

category_filtering.details: 12 categories (Diabetes, Heart Care, Pain Relief, etc.) with pill-style buttons. Clicking changes product grid and section title. Diabetes shows '20 of 31 products'

add_to_cart.details: Orange 'Add' buttons on cards. Click shows toast notification and replaces button with green quantity controls (+/-)

quantity_controls.details: Increment/decrement buttons work correctly. Green background with white text showing current quantity

sticky_cart_bar_mobile.details: Orange gradient bar at bottom showing item count, total price, and 'Checkout' button. Only visible on mobile viewport

upload_prescription_dialog.details: Dialog with dashed upload area, 'Click to upload prescription' text, PNG/JPG/PDF support up to 10MB, 'Upload & Continue' button

medicine_detail_dialog.details: Shows medicine name, form/category tags, composition, price, and 'Add to Cart' button. Opens on clicking product name/image

checkout_navigation.details: Sticky cart bar 'Checkout' button navigates to /pharmacy/checkout with 3-step process (Cart → Address → Payment)

ui_design_review.theme: Dark green (#166534) header with orange (#f97316) action buttons - matches requirements
ui_design_review.layout: Clean Blinkit-style grid layout with category pills and product cards
ui_design_review.mobile_responsive: Verified on 390x844 viewport - sticky cart bar and grid adjust correctly
ui_design_review.spacing_and_contrast: Good visual hierarchy, proper spacing, readable text contrast
